newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end mixed, retreat from trading high.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end mixed, retreat from trading high.

text.p: 1435 GMT - Dutch shares close mixed on Thursday, rebounding from a fresh trading high as profit-takers and options players chip away the early gains. Dealers say market undertone still positive on prospects of strong Dutch economic growth but AEX index struggling to break out beyond 572.50 June 6 peak.
* AEX closes 0.76 points higher at 571.37, well below the 574.25 trading high set around the midsession, but inches short of the 571.76 closing high recorded on June 6.
* Akzo down 90 cents at 203.20 guilders as profit-takers wade in after early climb to 206.00 on its Remeron prospects.
